rationale: The candidate is suitable for packaging. All four scientific endpoints of the original source (hrv_time, hrv_freq, hrv_nonlinear, hrv_indices) are preserved as required outputs; the only excluded branches are plot-only figures and preprocessing state, with source-backed reasons. The grader's public contract matches its executable behavior: exact column sets by name with free order, one data row, empty-vs-value semantics enforced (0-substitution for empty fails), a precisely specified plain-decimal grammar enforced by the regex before float() (whitespace-only/padded, underscore, nan/inf/hex text all rejected, matching the check descriptions), the stated tolerance |x-r| <= max(1e-9|r|, 1e-12) with reference denominator and the <= boundary correctly described, and cross-table consistency that fails rather than passes vacuously when any file is missing or malformed. Controls were freshly executed and are internally consistent with control_summary (18/18 expected outcomes met: reference, recomputed, alternative, empty, misplaced, 4 missing, 9 probes). Submission placement is verified from the hash records (files at the submission root pass; an extra outputs/ layer fails, consistent with the artifact interface). The comparison basis is defensible: reference CSVs are shortest-round-trip float64 decimals, the oracle recomputation and the independently executed alternative produced byte-identical outputs (matching sha256), and both valid-representation probes (%.17g re-encoding, per-domain column reordering) pass while all seven wrong-solution probes (per-domain value perturbations, NaN text, tolerance boundary 1e-5 shift, combined-only mismatch, zero-for-empty substitution) fail with specific diagnostics and without crashes. The check-description updates genuinely tighten the grammar and boundary wording without relaxing any scientific obligation. Repeated reference replays were byte-identical. Two annotation-level observations do not affect acceptance: (1) the combined-cross-consistency probe rationale mentions a stale print message ('keeps cross-table equality') that no longer exists in the executed script (it prints 'breaks cross-table equality'); the intended effect is nonetheless established by the controller's before/after hashes and grader report, and the frozen mutation need not be changed; (2) the tight tolerance effectively requires agreement with the pinned NeuroKit2 0.2.13 path — this tension with 'any implementation may be used' is disclosed in the candidate's concern list and the addendum, matches the policy's statement that broad implementation independence is not promised, and must not be widened retroactively or claimed as universal portability.

source_coverage.rationale: Audited the converted source and narrative, the preparation plan and the export code against the candidate's outputs. The original script's terminal scientific results are exactly the four one-row HRV tables: hrv_time (nk.hrv_time(peaks, sampling_rate=100, show=True)), hrv_freq (nk.hrv_frequency(peaks, sampling_rate=100, show=True, normalize=True)), hrv_nonlinear (nk.hrv_nonlinear(peaks, sampling_rate=100, show=True)) and hrv_indices (nk.hrv(peaks, sampling_rate=100, show=True)). All four are exported verbatim (hrv_time.csv, hrv_frequency.csv, hrv_nonlinear.csv, hrv_indices.csv), and the observed reference profiles confirm the full 25/10/60/95 column sets including every MFDFA, asymmetry, fragmentation, complexity and symbolic index, plus the reference's empty fields (SDANN2/SDNNI2/SDANN5/SDNNI5, ULF). The only excluded items are the raw recording, peaks series and info dict (inputs/preprocessing, not independently interpreted results) and the show=True figures (RR histogram, PSD plot, Poincare scattergram) - plot-only visualizations whose underlying values are already contained in the exported tables, a permitted diagnostic/visualization exclusion, not a discarded scientific branch. No endpoint in the original source is missing from the task and no scientific scope was narrowed; the combined table is retained as its own endpoint as narrated in the source. No supplied intermediates replace a required endpoint: the solver receives only the raw ECG recording and must reproduce the full raw-ECG-to-indices pipeline.
